text_description: Full-length runway look centered on a slim, sleeveless ivory/cream dress with strong black contrast edging. The upper bodice is close and fluid, cut with a deep V neckline outlined in narrow black binding that continues into thin shoulder straps; a small black circular medallion-like detail sits at the lower point of the V on the chest. The fabric falls softly into an asymmetrical waist treatment, where the front is gathered and tied at the model's left waist into a knot with long black sash ends hanging downward. A black band wraps diagonally across the hips, creating a graphic, layered effect over the pale base. The skirt is narrow and below-knee in length, with an asymmetrical high slit on the model's left side exposing the thigh and edged by black trim; the lower hem also has black border accents and a second small dark emblem near the front lower skirt. The palette is minimal ivory and black with a sharp, graphic resort/evening feel, styled with bare arms, minimal visible jewelry, and a faint glimpse of red footwear at the bottom edge.

The fabric falls softly into an asymmetrical waist treatment, where the front is gathered and tied at the model's left waist into a knot with long black sash ends hanging downward. A black band wraps diagonally across the hips, creating a graphic, layered effect over the pale base. The skirt is narrow and below-knee in length, with an asymmetrical high slit on the model's left side exposing the thigh and edged by black trim; the lower hem also has black border accents and a second small dark emblem near the front lower skirt. The palette is minimal ivory and black with a sharp, graphic resort/evening feel, styled with bare arms, minimal visible jewelry, and a faint glimpse of red footwear at the bottom edge.
